new_value: {"notes":"Added fixed Zephyr link-profile constants in lichen/link.h: CAD timeout 3 symbols, backoff unit 10 ms, maximum exponent 5, retry limit 3. Kept them out of Kconfig because section 14.5 fixes protocol values rather than exposing tunables; existing TDMA contention min/max Kconfig controls are a separate join-backoff mechanism. Added focused compile-time/runtime host tests validating all constants, CW=31 at exponent 5, and attempt 4 exhaustion after 3 retries. AppleClang/UBSan ctest passed 1/1; git diff --check and clang-format dry-run passed."}
